subjects.name: HTML & Semantic Web
subjects.description: Master semantic layout, accessibility (ARIA/WCAG), HTML parser pipeline, DOM generation, web components, forms, SEO, and security headers.

subjects.name: CSS & Modern Layouts
subjects.description: Deep-dive into the CSS Cascade, specificity calculations, Stacking Contexts, Flexbox, Grid, Container Queries, GPU compositing, animations, and zero-runtime architecture.

subjects.name: JavaScript Core & Engine
subjects.description: V8 engine internals, Execution Contexts, Lexical Scope, Closures, Prototypal Inheritance, Event Loop, Microtask Queue, Memory Profiling, and Garbage Collection.

subjects.name: ES6+ & Modern ECMAScript
subjects.description: Comprehensive mastery of modern ECMAScript standards: arrow functions, destructuring, classes, Symbols, Proxies, Reflect, Iterators, Generators, optional chaining, and nullish coalescing.

subjects.name: DOM & Mutation Architecture
subjects.description: Document tree traversal, Node vs Element, live collections, Layout Thrashing, reflow/repaint triggers, MutationObserver, and high-frequency DOM manipulation.

subjects.name: BOM & Browser Runtime
subjects.description: The Window object, Navigation, History API (pushState/replaceState), Location, Screen, Viewports, Timers (rAF, rIC), and client-side storage mechanics.

subjects.name: Modern Web APIs
subjects.description: Fetch API with AbortController, Web Workers, Service Workers & Offline PWA, Cache API, IndexedDB, WebSockets, WebRTC, Streams, and Web Crypto.

subjects.name: jQuery & Legacy Architecture
subjects.description: Fundamentals, the $ alias, selectors, DOM manipulation, traversal, event delegation, AJAX, animation, plugins, $.extend(), legacy enterprise apps, and jQuery-to-React migration.

subjects.name: TypeScript Advanced Type System
subjects.description: Type inference, Unions, Intersections, Generics, Conditional types, infer keyword, Template literal types, Mapped types, Narrowing, and tsconfig strict mode.

subjects.name: React.js & Modern Architecture
subjects.description: React 19, JSX internals, Fiber Work Loop, Reconciliation, Hooks deep mechanics (useState, useEffect, useMemo), Suspense, Error Boundaries, and Server Components.

subjects.name: Redux & State Architecture
subjects.description: Redux Core, Unidirectional Data Flow, Redux Toolkit (RTK), createSlice, RTK Query, Thunk Middleware, Reselect Memoization, and Normalized State Design.

subjects.name: React Router & Navigation
subjects.description: Client-side routing architecture, createBrowserRouter, nested routes, loaders, actions, defer, useSearchParams, and layout transitions.

subjects.name: TanStack Query & Server State
subjects.description: Server state management, background refetching, stale-while-revalidate, mutations, optimistic updates, query key factories, and caching mechanics.

subjects.name: Next.js & Fullstack SSR/SSG
subjects.description: App Router, Server Components (RSC), Client Components ('use client'), Server Actions, SSR, SSG, ISR, Streaming with Suspense, and SEO optimization.

subjects.name: HTTP Protocol & Networking
subjects.description: HTTP request/response lifecycle, HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3 (QUIC), status codes, headers, caching (ETag, Cache-Control), CORS, and TCP/TLS handshakes.

subjects.name: REST APIs & Contract Design
subjects.description: REST architectural constraints, HTTP verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), idempotency, HATEOAS, API versioning, error payload standards, and pagination.

subjects.name: WebSockets & Real-Time Comms
subjects.description: Full-duplex bi-directional communication, WebSocket handshake (HTTP 101 Switching Protocols), heartbeat ping/pong, reconnection backoff, and SSE vs WebSockets.

subjects.name: Browser Internals & Rendering Engine
subjects.description: HTML/CSS parsing, DOM & CSSOM tree construction, Render Tree, Layout (Reflow), Paint (Repaint), GPU Compositing, and Layout Thrashing.

subjects.name: Web Performance & Core Web Vitals
subjects.description: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), asset optimization, code-splitting, tree-shaking, lazy loading, resource hints (preload, preconnect, dns-prefetch), and bundle analysis.

subjects.name: Web Accessibility (a11y & ARIA)
subjects.description: WCAG 2.2 guidelines, semantic HTML vs ARIA, keyboard accessibility (tabindex, focus trap), screen reader compatibility, color contrast, and live regions.

subjects.name: Modern SEO & Web Crawlers
subjects.description: Search engine crawler architecture, Open Graph & Twitter cards, JSON-LD Schema structured data, canonical URLs, robots.txt, sitemaps, and SSR for indexing.

subjects.name: Frontend Security & OWASP Top 10
subjects.description: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), Content Security Policy (CSP), secure cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), and Clickjacking.

subjects.name: Frontend Testing (Unit, E2E, Integration)
subjects.description: Testing Trophy vs Testing Pyramid, Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library (RTL), Playwright, Cypress, mocking network calls (MSW), and accessibility testing.

subjects.name: Git & GitHub Workflows
subjects.description: Git object model (blobs, trees, commits), merge vs rebase, interactive rebase, cherry-pick, git bisect, stash, merge conflict resolution, and trunk-based development.

subjects.name: Modern Build Tools & Bundlers
subjects.description: Vite, esbuild, Rollup, Webpack 5, Turbopack, Rspack, native ES modules (ESM), Hot Module Replacement (HMR), tree-shaking, and code splitting.

subjects.name: Micro Frontends & Module Federation
subjects.description: Micro frontend architecture, Webpack 5 Module Federation, iframe isolation, single-spa, shared dependencies, cross-app communication, and independent deployments.

subjects.name: Frontend Design Patterns & SOLID
subjects.description: Creational, structural, and behavioral patterns in frontend: Observer, Singleton, Factory, Compound Components, Render Props, Provider Pattern, and SOLID principles.

subjects.name: Frontend Architecture & Scalability
subjects.description: Feature-sliced design, modular monorepos (Turborepo, Nx), state management boundaries, API abstraction layers, error handling strategies, and design systems.

subjects.name: Machine Coding & Component Implementation
subjects.description: Building production-grade UI widgets from scratch in 45-60 minutes: Autocomplete Search, Infinite Scroll, Star Rating, File Tree, Modal, Carousel, and Virtualized List.

subjects.name: Frontend System Design & Architecture
subjects.description: End-to-end frontend architecture for large-scale systems: Design Google Docs, Design Netflix Video Streaming, Design WhatsApp Web, Design Infinite Newsfeed, and Design E-commerce Checkout.

subjects.name: Frontend Coding Problems & DSA
subjects.description: Practical frontend algorithms and JavaScript implementations: Custom Promise.all, Deep Clone, Flatten Array/Object, Event Emitter, Memoize, Curry, and LRU Cache.

subjects.name: Scenario-Based Frontend Engineering
subjects.description: Debugging production memory leaks, diagnosing sudden Core Web Vitals drops, handling flaky network requests, zero-downtime releases, and race condition resolutions.
